tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-white, no hue.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and the editor canvas set on `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: File tree, sidebars, footer, table headers.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: The deep brand block: code panels, terminal (start-env), the cover slab. Text on it is `hull-ink`.

tokens.name: hull-ink
tokens.usage: Text and code on `hull`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `paper`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata (timeouts, file sizes) on `paper` and `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and draggable blocks; meets 3:1 on `paper` and `surface`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Brand orange. One filled signal button per view (Launch, Get started) and a few deliberate highlights.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` fill.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Harbor references and nop's expected 0. Never decoration.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Check passed: `oracle` reward = 1, lint clean. Always paired with a check glyph and the word 'pass'.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Check failed: oracle < 1, nop > 0 (task leaks), build error. Always paired with a cross glyph and the word 'fail'; never told apart from `pass` by hue alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Flaky or unverified: lint warnings, task not yet run against oracle.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only, one per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Write the instruction the agent will see.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and block-type tags.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Editors, terminal, inline file names such as `task.toml`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, block header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between editor panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on landing and docs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, tree rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Task blocks, tables, dialogs, code panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Landing page hero cards.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: Only on a block while it is being dragged. Everything at rest uses borders, not shadows.
